evaluation_name: One fixed subject-held-out RGB baseline evaluation
dataset: 100-image RT-BENE research subset; 50 OPEN and 50 CLOSED

model.features: 30x18 grayscale pixels divided by 255, StandardScaler fitted on training images only

limitations: Only 100 selected images from 10 people; held-out sample is very small.
No cross-camera, NIR, ICU-patient or clinical validation.
Subject-independent within this subset does not establish population generalization.
This baseline differs from the previously reported Orange image-embedding experiment on 71 images.
No segmentation, partial-opening or clinical corneal-exposure labels.
Model score and alert timing are uncalibrated engineering demonstration settings.

runtime_abstention_holdout.note: Quality gates and score abstention are heuristic; this is not a clinical uncertainty validation.
